The user wants two in-app banner texts for a cloud backup app:
- s1: backup finished banner (2,314 files, 1.2 GB)
- s2: storage 95% full banner (user can upgrade or delete files)

Return only JSON with s1 and s2 keys. Should be concise, banner-appropriate copy. Keep it clean, professional, friendly.

s1: "Backup complete — 2,314 files (1.2 GB) safely stored in the cloud."
s2: "Your cloud storage is 95% full. Upgrade your plan or delete files to free up space."

Format: only JSON, no extra text. Keep strings as banner copy. Maybe include action hints like "Upgrade" — but banner text, keep it one sentence. Ensure valid JSON, escape nothing needed except careful with quotes. Use plain apostrophes? Avoid apostrophes to keep JSON simple, or fine to include. I'll avoid tricky characters.</think>{"s1":"Backup complete! 2,314 files (1.2 GB) are safely stored in the cloud.","s2":"Your cloud storage is 95% full. Upgrade your plan or delete files to free up space."}

parsed.s1: Backup complete! 2,314 files (1.2 GB) are safely stored in the cloud.
parsed.s2: Your cloud storage is 95% full. Upgrade your plan or delete files to free up space.
